title: Step 1: amazon_reviews.py loader, enriched pool builder and ID/hash manifest
description:
## Purpose

Step 1: `amazon_reviews.py` loader + enriched pool builder + manifest of IDs/hashes.

## Scope

- Load McAuley Lab Amazon Reviews 2023 for Cell_Phones_and_Accessories, Home_and_Kitchen, Toys_and_Games; 2013-2016; 15-90 words.
- Candidate pool 3,000 enriched toward 1-2 star and keyword hits (ship/seller/refund/return/package/$/price/http/"in exchange"/"discount"); seeded.
- Manifest of review IDs, split/index identifiers, normalized-text hashes, dataset revision. Text stays under gitignored `var/`/`.data/`.
- Spec beside the module with ~50 synthetic reviews; no network in specs.

## Definition of done

`amazon_reviews_test.py` passes offline; `make test` green; planted/Emotion/FOMC replays byte-identical; no review text committed. No real download until L0 is closed (blocked-by L0).

## Caps

$0 (offline). Opus sub-agent builds; main session reviews and pushes.

comments.text: Done in 7c8b388 (local, not pushed). amazon_reviews.py + spec (16 specs, synthetic, no network). Download: 18 HTTP byte ranges (6 x 8 MiB per category, spread through each raw review file) at HF revision 2b6d039e, 150,994,944 bytes in gitignored .data/amazon-reviews/, each range's url/offsets/bytes/sha256 in download.json and the committed manifest. Eligible after 2013-2016 + 15-90 words + dedupe: 39,792. Pool 3,000 (seed 20261002): ratings 1:1158 2:642 3:450 4:152 5:598; strata low-kw 720, low-plain 1080, mid-kw 180, mid-plain 270, high-kw 300, high-plain 450; categories Cell 1228, Home 885, Toys 887. Natural 300 (disjoint): ratings 1:24 2:12 3:24 4:42 5:198, keyword hits 45. Text only in var/amazon-reviews/{pool,natural}.jsonl; studies/amazon_reviews/manifest.json is text-free (8-gram check vs pool: 0 overlaps).
